FROM smart_small.entity_table e

    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 220
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 330 AND 335
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 
    ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v1.property_id = 120
    AND v1.value = '内部'
    AND v2.property_id = 121
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) <= 1000
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT MIN(CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15))) AS result
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 164
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
natural_language: 数据库中应变的最小值是多少？

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：过时效状态在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−1300mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 121
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50000.0
    AND v2.property_id = 122
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 15.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 有哪些数据晶粒体积大于50000，半径也大于15？
natural_language_en: Which data have grain volume greater than 50000 and radius greater than 15?

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 130
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN -180.23 AND -180.15
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 130
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN -180 AND -179.98
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 225
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50.0
    AND v2.property_id = 123
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 5000.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找库中平均宽度在50以上、表面积超过5000的晶粒数据
natural_language_en: Find grain data in the database with average width above 50 and surface area exceeding 5000.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 123
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 10000.0
    AND v2.property_id = 119
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) >= 15.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找表面积过10000的晶粒，其面数也不能低于15
natural_language_en: Find grains with surface area over 10000 and number of faces not less than 15.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 46
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.5
    AND v2.property_id = 148
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 1.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id

    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 134
    
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 21.70 AND 23.70
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 3
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND v.value = 'RPV钢铁'
    AND v2.property_id = 219
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 2
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 141
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 30.0
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 10.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找湿度30以上，同时温度也高于10的数据
natural_language_en: Find data with humidity above 30 and temperature higher than 10 at the same time.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 40
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.05
    AND v2.property_id = 63
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) >3
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 146
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.05
    AND v2.property_id = 141
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 40.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 开位电路大于0.05、湿度还超过40的数据
natural_language_en: Data with open-circuit potential greater than 0.05 and humidity exceeding 40.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 125
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > -50.0
    AND v2.property_id = 127
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 100.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: p型载流子浓度大于-50的同时电导率还过100的，都有谁
natural_language_en: Which data have p-type carrier concentration greater than -50 and p-type electrical conductivity greater than 100?

sql:
SELECT MIN(CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15))) AS min_value
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 143
    
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL;
natural_language: 统计数据库中pH值的最小值。
natural_language_en: Compute the minimum pH value in the database.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 125
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > -100.0
    AND v2.property_id = 129
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 5.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查一下p型载流子浓度在-100以上、n型载流子浓度也大于5的数据
natural_language_en: Check data with p-type carrier concentration above -100 and n-type carrier concentration greater than 5.

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 141
    
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 1.9
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 127
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 100000.0
    AND v2.property_id = 131
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 10000.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找p型电导率超10万、n型也过1万的
natural_language_en: Find data with p-type conductivity exceeding 100000 and n-type also over 10000.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 127
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 100000.0
    AND v2.property_id = 129
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 1.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 134
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 300.0
    AND v2.property_id = 7
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 1.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 温度300以上且密度也大于1的数据
natural_language_en: Data with temperature above 300 and density greater than 1.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 56
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 5.0
    AND v2.property_id = 61
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: Ti含量大于5，Co也超过50的这种材料有哪些
natural_language_en: Which materials have Ti content greater than 5 and Co exceeding 50?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 61
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50.0
    AND v2.property_id = 75
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: Co含量超过50、Nb含量还大于0的材料有哪些
natural_language_en: Which materials have Co content exceeding 50 and Nb content greater than 0?

sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id FROM smart_small.entity_table e JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v3 ON v3.data_id = e.data_id WHERE v1.property_id = 1 AND v1.value = '7075' AND v2.property_id = 164 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND v3.property_id = 165 AND CAST(v3.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 400 ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 牌号为7075且应变和应力分别位于4到6之间和大于400的数据
natural_language_en: Data with grade 7075, strain between 4 and 6 and stress greater than 400.

data.加工工艺: 材料为76mm 厚的7075 铝合金板材。7075 铝合金的供货热处理状态为T7351 。峰时效T6 热处理:先将7075-T7351 在465 ℃固溶30min , 用冷水淬火, 然后在120 ℃时效24h , 再空冷。回归再时效(RRA)热处理:将7075-T6 在203 ℃回归10min , 然后在120 ℃时效24h , 空冷。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: T7351：恒极化电位-800mV下，在3.5%NaCl溶液中进行慢应变速率拉伸，拉伸应变速率为9.68×10^-7/s^-1。

sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id FROM smart_small.entity_table e JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v3 ON v3.data_id = e.data_id WHERE v1.property_id = 138 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 113 AND 114 AND v2.property_id = 139 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 29 AND 30 AND v3.property_id = 148 AND CAST(v3.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.02 ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT MIN(CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15))) AS min_value
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 149
    
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL;
natural_language: 统计数据库中已腐蚀量的最小值。
natural_language_en: Compute the minimum corroded amount in the database.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 61
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 40.0 AND 60.0
    AND v2.property_id = 108
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 2.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v1.property_id = 134 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 17.10
    AND v2.property_id = 141 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 35.40
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 189
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 200.0
    AND v2.property_id = 158
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 300.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 189
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 100.0
    AND v2.property_id = 157
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 160.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 189
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 200.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 48
  AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.02 AND 2.78
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

data.加工工艺: 从12mm厚的7020铝合金轧制板材，切取长150mm宽30mm的试样，在SX−4−10型箱式电阻炉中470℃/h固溶后，分别在室温水(约20℃)、沸水、空气中冷却至室温，然后立即在空气炉中进行人工时效，时效工艺为(90℃,12h)+(170℃,11h)。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 在3.5%NaCl溶液中，冷却速率1720 ℃/min，进行慢应变速率试验,拉伸速率为1×10^−6 s^−1.

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：峰时效状态在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−1100mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

result_data.title: 轻质高强合金应力腐蚀

data.加工工艺: 7003铝合金的热处理由固溶及时效两个步骤组成；时效处理分为3种时效制度：峰时效PA、双峰时效DPA及回归再时效RRA。PA：470℃×2h+120℃×50h；DPA：470℃×2h+120℃×120h；RRA：470℃×2h+120℃×48h+205℃×10min+120℃×48h

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 双峰时效(DPA)时在3.5%的NaCl溶液中进行慢应力拉伸试验，拉伸应变速率为9.5×10^-7 s^-1。取样方向：纵向

data.加工工艺: 7003铝合金的热处理由固溶及时效两个步骤组成；时效处理分为3种时效制度：峰时效PA、双峰时效DPA及回归再时效RRA。PA：470℃×2h+120℃×50h；DPA：470℃×2h+120℃×120h；RRA：470℃×2h+120℃×48h+205℃×10min+120℃×48h

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 双峰时效(DPA)时在干燥空气，在阴极电位为-900mV时进行慢应力拉伸试验，拉伸应变速率为9.5×10^-7 s^-1。取样方向：纵向。

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：峰时效状态在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−1300mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

data.加工工艺: 材料为76mm 厚的7075 铝合金板材。7075 铝合金的供货热处理状态为T7351 。峰时效T6 热处理:先将7075-T7351 在465 ℃固溶30min , 用冷水淬火, 然后在120 ℃时效24h , 再空冷。回归再时效(RRA)热处理:将7075-T6 在203 ℃回归10min , 然后在120 ℃时效24h , 空冷。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: T7351：恒极化电位-720mV下，在3.5%NaCl溶液中进行慢应变速率拉伸，拉伸应变速率为9.68×10^-7/s^-1。

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：过时效状态在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−1300mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

data.加工工艺: 铸锭在560 ℃下均匀化9h后，在490℃下保温2h经四道次进行75%的热变形，随后进行退火（320℃/2h）以去除轧制过程中产生的内应力，最后进行T6 峰时效处理（535℃固溶1.5h，180℃时效9h）。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 试验条件：铸态6061铝合金在空气中进行慢应变速率拉伸试验，应变速率为6.67×10^-6 s^-1。

data.加工工艺: 从12mm厚的7020铝合金轧制板材，切取长150mm宽30mm的试样，在SX−4−10型箱式电阻炉中470℃/h固溶后，分别在室温水(约20℃)、沸水、空气中冷却至室温，然后立即在空气炉中进行人工时效，时效工艺为(90℃,12h)+(170℃,11h)。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 在3.5%NaCl溶液中，冷却速率30℃/min，进行慢应变速率试验,拉伸速率为1×10^−6 s^−1。

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 59
  AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.12 AND 1.95
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 回归再时效(RRA)时在干燥空气中，在阴极电位为-1400mV时进行慢应力拉伸试验，拉伸应变速率为9.5×10^-7 s^-1。取样方向：纵向。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 双峰时效(DPA)时在干燥空气，在阴极电位为-900mV时进行慢应力拉伸试验，拉伸应变速率为9.5×10^-7 s^-1。取样方向：纵向。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 试验条件：铸态6061铝合金在空气中进行慢应变速率拉伸试验，应变速率为6.67×10^-6 s^-1。

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 49
  AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.04
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：欠时效状态下在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−800mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 56
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
    AND v2.property_id = 48
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 48
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.4
    AND v2.property_id = 60
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.2
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 35
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.01
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 75
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 20.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 那些材料数据铌含量0.1以上、温度还高于20
natural_language_en: Those material data with niobium content above 0.1 and temperature higher than 20.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id FROM smart_small.entity_table e JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id WHERE v1.property_id = 21 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) = 500 AND v2.property_id = 22 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) <= 1000 ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 屈服强度为500且抗拉强度不超过1000的数据有哪些？
natural_language_en: Which data have yield strength of 500 and tensile strength not exceeding 1000?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 29
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 30.0
    AND v2.property_id = 50
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.01
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 29
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 10.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 41
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.1
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) = 25.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 筛选出氮含量低于0.1，环境温度是25的数据

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 31
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 25.0
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) = 25.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 哪些材料数据伸长率大于25而环境温度刚好25？
natural_language_en: Which material data have elongation greater than 25 while ambient temperature is exactly 25?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 149
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 5.0
    AND v2.property_id = 143
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

natural_language_en: Which materials have pH value and corroded amount both above 5?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 222
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50.0
    AND v2.property_id = 220
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) = 1000.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 纳米压痕模量大于50、压入深度等于1000的数据

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 141
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 30.0
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 25.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

natural_language_en: Materials with humidity above 30 and temperature greater than 25.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
  AND v1.property_id = 40 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.05
    AND v2.property_id = 59 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.81
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;
natural_language: 碳大于 0.05 且锰大于 0.81 的数据有哪些？

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 61
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50.0
    AND v2.property_id = 75
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 1.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 58
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 10.0
    AND v2.property_id = 60
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 20.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 49
    AND v.value != ''

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 22
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 600.0
    AND v2.property_id = 32
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 抗拉强度大于600、断面收缩率还大于50的材料有哪些
natural_language_en: Which materials have tensile strength exceeding 600 and reduction of area over 50?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 1
    AND v.value = 'TiO2'
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 200.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id

    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.5
    AND v2.property_id = 48
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
 AND v1.property_id = 40 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.09
    AND v2.property_id = 59 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 1.15
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 61
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 50.0
    AND v2.property_id = 75
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 132
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.8
    AND v2.property_id = 129
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.2
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

result_data.title: 轻质高强合金应力腐蚀

data.加工工艺: 材料为76mm 厚的7075 铝合金板材。7075 铝合金的供货热处理状态为T7351 。峰时效T6 热处理:先将7075-T7351 在465 ℃固溶30min , 用冷水淬火, 然后在120 ℃时效24h , 再空冷。回归再时效(RRA)热处理:将7075-T6 在203 ℃回归10min , 然后在120 ℃时效24h , 空冷。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: T7351：恒极化电位-800mV下，在3.5%NaCl溶液中进行慢应变速率拉伸，拉伸应变速率为9.68×10^-7/s^-1。

result_data.title: 轻质高强合金应力腐蚀

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：欠时效状态下在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−800mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 58
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.5
    AND v2.property_id = 31
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 20.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 铬含量大于0.5，伸长率还过20的数据有哪些

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 29
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 30.0
    AND v2.property_id = 50
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 冲击吸收能不到30，而且含硫大于0.1的材料
natural_language_en: Materials with impact absorption energy below 30 and sulfur content greater than 0.1.

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 62
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 2.0
    AND v2.property_id = 32
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 40.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 镍含量超过2，断面收缩率还过40的材料

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 22
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 500.0 AND 700.0
    AND v2.property_id = 76
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 抗拉强度在500到700之间，钼含量大于0.1的材料
natural_language_en: Materials with tensile strength between 500 and 700 and molybdenum content above 0.1.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 62
  AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 20 AND 21
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;
natural_language: 请筛选库中满足Ni含量在20到21之间的合金
natural_language_en: Screen alloys in the database with Ni content between 20 and 21.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id FROM smart_small.entity_table e JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id WHERE v1.property_id = 121 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 150000 AND v2.property_id = 119 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 30 ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 找一找体积超过150000但面数却小于30的晶粒记录。
natural_language_en: Find grain records with volume exceeding 150000 but number of faces less than 30.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 50
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.1
    AND v2.property_id = 32
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 25.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 硫含量不到0.1，断面收缩率还超过25的材料有哪些
natural_language_en: Which materials have sulfur content below 0.1 and reduction of area exceeding 25?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 134
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 25.0
    AND v2.property_id = 32
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 30.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找环境温度低于25，断面收缩率还大于30的数据
natural_language_en: Find data with ambient temperature below 25 and reduction of area greater than 30.

FROM smart_small.entity_table e

WHERE v.property_id = 22

    AND v.value IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

SELECT MAX(CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15))) AS max_value
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 47
   AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL;
natural_language: 统计库中 Al含量的最大值。
natural_language_en: Compute the maximum Al content in the database.

sql:
SELECT MIN(CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15))) AS min_value
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 62
   AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL;
natural_language: 统计数据库中Ni含量的最小值。
natural_language_en: Compute the minimum Ni content in the database.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id FROM smart_small.entity_table e JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id WHERE v1.property_id = 145 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 1000000 AND v2.property_id = 148 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.5 ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 若材料的极化电阻大于1000000，同时其腐蚀速率小于0.5，这类数据有哪些？

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 21
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 400.0
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 500.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 温度超过500时屈服强度不到400的这种数据有哪些
natural_language_en: Which data have yield strength below 400 and temperature exceeding 500?

sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id FROM smart_small.entity_table e JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id JOIN smart_small.value_table v3 ON v3.data_id = e.data_id WHERE v1.property_id = 31 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) >= 25 AND v2.property_id = 58 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) >= 15 AND v3.property_id = 134 AND CAST(v3.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) >= 25 ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 31
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 30.0 AND 70.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 材料伸长率在30到70之间的有哪些
natural_language_en: Which materials have elongation between 30 and 70?

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v1.property_id = 163 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.63
    AND v2.property_id = 162 AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 23.57
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 31
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 20.0 AND 50.0
    AND v2.property_id = 41

FROM smart_small.entity_table e

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 58
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 15.0
    AND v2.property_id = 25
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 15000.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找那些铬含量不到15，弹性模量还得过15000的数据
natural_language_en: Find data with chromium content below 15 and elastic modulus above 15000.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 29
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 40.0
    AND v2.property_id = 49
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 冲击功超过40，磷还低于0.1的数据有哪些

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 31
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 20.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 将数据库当中延伸率在20以下的数据全列出来
natural_language_en: List all data in the database with elongation below 20.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 189
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 40.0 AND 100.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 筛选出库中硬度在40到100之间的材料
natural_language_en: Screen materials in the database with hardness between 40 and 100.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 189
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 40.0
    AND v2.property_id = 57
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 有哪些材料数据硬度大于40、钒还超过0.1的

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 191
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 1000.0
    AND v2.property_id = 62
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.2
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 190
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 300.0
    AND v2.property_id = 63
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找上屈服强度过300，铜不到0.5的数据
natural_language_en: Find data with upper yield strength over 300 and copper below 0.5.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 21
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 300.0 AND 700.0
    AND v2.property_id = 50
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 屈服强度在300到700之间、硫含量不到0.1的材料有哪些
natural_language_en: Which materials have yield strength between 300 and 700 and sulfur content below 0.1?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 11
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 100.0 AND 700.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找比热在100到700之间的数据
natural_language_en: Find data with specific heat between 100 and 700.

FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id

sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15))) AS average_value
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 64
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL;
natural_language: 统计数据库中锌的平均值。
natural_language_en: Compute the average zinc content in the database.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 11
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 400.0
    AND v2.property_id = 40
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找数据，其比热需要超过400，碳含量还得大于0.1
natural_language_en: Find data whose specific heat exceeds 400 and carbon content is also greater than 0.1.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
  AND v.property_id = 40
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.1 AND 5.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
  AND v.property_id = 59
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.3 AND 2.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
  AND v.property_id = 48
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.1 AND 3.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

data.加工工艺: 从12mm厚的7020铝合金轧制板材，切取长150mm宽30mm的试样，在SX−4−10型箱式电阻炉中470℃/h固溶后，分别在室温水(约20℃)、沸水、空气中冷却至室温，然后立即在空气炉中进行人工时效，时效工艺为(90℃,12h)+(170℃,11h)。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 在3.5%NaCl溶液中，冷却速率1720 ℃/min，进行慢应变速率试验,拉伸速率为1×10^−6 s^−1.

data.加工工艺: 铸锭在560 ℃下均匀化9h后，在490℃下保温2h经四道次进行75%的热变形，随后进行退火（320℃/2h）以去除轧制过程中产生的内应力，最后进行T6 峰时效处理（535℃固溶1.5h，180℃时效9h）。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 试验条件：铸态6061铝合金在空气中进行慢应变速率拉伸试验，应变速率为6.67×10^-6 s^-1。

data.加工工艺: 从12mm厚的7020铝合金轧制板材，切取长150mm宽30mm的试样，在SX−4−10型箱式电阻炉中470℃/h固溶后，分别在室温水(约20℃)、沸水、空气中冷却至室温，然后立即在空气炉中进行人工时效，时效工艺为(90℃,12h)+(170℃,11h)。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 在3.5%NaCl溶液中，冷却速率30℃/min，进行慢应变速率试验,拉伸速率为1×10^−6 s^−1。

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 25
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 150.0 AND 300.0
    AND v2.property_id = 50
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.1
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id

    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 500.0
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 700.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id FROM smart_small.entity_table e JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id WHERE v1.property_id = 164 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) >= 2 AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) <= 8 ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 回归再时效(RRA)时在干燥空气中，在阴极电位为-1000mV时进行慢应力拉伸试验，拉伸应变速率为9.5×10^-7 s^-1。取样方向：纵向。

data.加工工艺: 加工工艺：样品取自美国Alcoa公司生产的7050铝合金55mm厚板材，采用三种热处理制度，欠时效热处理：先将合金在470℃保温2h，冷水淬火，然后在135℃时效8h。峰时效和过时效处理和上述过程相同，时效时间分别为16h和24h。

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：过时效状态在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−1300mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 10
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 1.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 10
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.5
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 100.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 电阻率0.1到0.5，温度还过100的数据有哪些
natural_language_en: Which data have resistivity between 0.1 and 0.5 and temperature above 100?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 26
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.2
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 500.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 26
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 0.2 AND 0.4
    AND v2.property_id = 48
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 1.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 163
    AND v.value != ''

    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 1.0 AND 10.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 193
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 30.0
    AND v2.property_id = 134
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 200.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id

ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 193
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 20.0
    AND v2.property_id = 40
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 58
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.1
    AND v2.property_id = 59
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 31
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 25.0
    AND v2.property_id = 62
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.4
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找延伸率大于25，镍还低于0.4的材料数据
natural_language_en: Find material data with elongation greater than 25 and nickel below 0.4.

JOIN smart_small.value_table v

data.加工工艺: 7003铝合金的热处理由固溶及时效两个步骤组成；时效处理分为3种时效制度：峰时效PA、双峰时效DPA及回归再时效RRA。PA：470℃×2h+120℃×50h；DPA：470℃×2h+120℃×120h；RRA：470℃×2h+120℃×48h+205℃×10min+120℃×48h

应力腐蚀.实验条件: 实验条件：欠时效状态下在3.5%NaCl(质量分数)水溶液中，取样方向为短横(S−T)向，在阴极极化电位−800mV下进行拉伸性能测试，应变速率为1×10^-6 s^-1。

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 
    ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v1.property_id = 120
    AND v1.value = '外部'
    AND v2.property_id = 121
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) <= 1000

sql:
SELECT MAX(CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15))) AS result
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 164
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
natural_language: 数据库中应变的最大值是多少？
natural_language_en: What is the maximum strain in the database?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 122
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 189
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) BETWEEN 50.0 AND 200.0
    AND v2.property_id = 40
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 查找硬度50到200之间，碳还低于0.5的材料
natural_language_en: Find materials with hardness between 50 and 200 and carbon below 0.5.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 58
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.2
    AND v2.property_id = 59
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 那些数据Cr含量大于0.2，锰还超过0.5
natural_language_en: Those data with Cr content greater than 0.1 and manganese exceeding 0.5.

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 219
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) = 5.0
    AND v2.property_id = 220
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 800.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC
natural_language: 有哪些数据辐照剂量为5、压入深度还超过800
natural_language_en: Which data have irradiation dose of 5 and indentation depth exceeding 800?

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v1.property_id = 25
    AND v1.value != '' AND v1.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 222
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v1 ON v1.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
  AND v1.property_id = 221
    AND v1.value != '' AND v1.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v1.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 3.5
    AND v2.property_id = 76
    AND v2.value != '' AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) < 0.5
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT e.data_id
FROM smart_small.entity_table e
JOIN smart_small.value_table v 
    ON v.data_id = e.data_id
JOIN smart_small.value_table v2 
    ON v2.data_id = e.data_id
WHERE v.property_id = 221
    AND v.value != ''
    AND v.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 3.0
    AND v2.property_id = 220
    AND v2.value != ''
    AND v2.value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(v2.value AS DECIMAL(30, 15)) > 500.0
ORDER BY e.data_id ASC

sql:

JOIN smart_small.value_table v
